page.title: Integrations
page.subtitle: What automations may call outside Cellhive, and the secrets they sign or authenticate with.
page.whoSees: Only owners and admins of the organization see this page.

allowlist.title: HTTP allowlist
allowlist.intro: Automations call public addresses on ports 80 and 443 only. Add a host here to let them reach it on your internal network, or on another port.

rules.patterns: A host (n8n.internal, or n8n for a Docker service) or *.suffix with at least two labels (*.corp.example — not corp.example itself). No IP address or range.
rules.ports: Add :port for another port (n8n.internal:5678). Without a port, the entry covers 80 and 443.
rules.loopback: This server itself (localhost, 127.0.0.1) is reached only through an exact host with its port.
rules.never: Cloud metadata, broadcast and reserved addresses are always blocked, whatever this list says.

allowlist.offTitle: Internal addresses stay closed on this server
allowlist.off: The administrator of this server set HTTP_PRIVATE_ALLOWLIST=off: entries only open another port on a public host. They never open an internal address.
allowlist.noteHint: Why automations may call it, e.g. Internal n8n.
allowlist.empty: No host yet: automations reach public addresses on ports 80 and 443 only.
allowlist.removeDescription: Calls already on their way finish; from the next one, automations calling this host on an internal address or this port are blocked.

error.pattern: Enter a host such as n8n.internal or *.corp.example, optionally with :port. IP addresses and ranges are not accepted.

secrets.title: HTTP secrets
secrets.intro: Values HTTP request and n8n steps send without showing them: a header value (API key, token) or a signing secret (Standard Webhooks). Builders choose them by name; nobody can read them back.

kindHint.http_header: An API key or token sent as a header (Authorization, X-Api-Key…). The header name is set in the step.
kindHint.webhook_signing: A whsec_… secret that signs each request (webhook-signature). Cellhive can generate it; you paste it into the receiver (n8n…).

scope.unknownBase: A base you do not see

secrets.rotatingUntil: The previous value still signs until {{date}}.

form.description: The value is write-only: it is never shown again, not even to you.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Automation builders choose the secret by this name.
form.rotateHint: The previous value keeps signing for {{hours, number}} hours, so you have time to update the receiver.
form.signingValueHint: whsec_ followed by base64 of 24 to 64 bytes.
form.headerValueHint: The whole value, e.g. Bearer abc123. Printable characters, no line break, at most 4,096.
form.scopeHint: Changing the bases does not change automations: a step of a base left out fails when it runs.

error.format_http_header: Use printable characters only, without line breaks, at most 4,096.
error.format_webhook_signing: Paste a value of the form whsec_… (base64 of 24 to 64 bytes).
error.hosts_invalid: Each entry must be a host name (api.example.com), *.example.com or host:port — no IP address, scheme or path.

form.allowedHostsHint: Automations send this secret only to these hosts.
form.allowedHostsLegacyHint: This secret has no allowed hosts yet: it is sent to any host until its transition period ends, then steps using it fail. Add the hosts it may be sent to.

reveal.description: Copy the secret of {{name}} into the receiving system now.
reveal.warning: Cellhive does not keep a readable copy: once this window is closed, the value cannot be shown again. Generate a new value if it is lost.
reveal.label: Signing secret
reveal.hint: Paste it where the receiver verifies Standard Webhooks signatures.
reveal.rotated: The previous value keeps signing until {{date}}.
reveal.confirm: I stored the secret in a safe place
reveal.nag: Confirm you stored the secret: it cannot be shown again.

rotate.title: New value for {{name}}?
rotate.description: Cellhive generates a new secret and shows it once. Requests carry both signatures for {{hours, number}} hours, then only the new one.
rotate.again: A previous value is still signing: generating again drops the oldest one now.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Automations can no longer use it.
delete.usages_one: {{count, number}} automation uses this secret: change it first.
delete.usages_other: {{count, number}} automations use this secret: change them first.

legacy.pendingHint: Created before allowed hosts existed: still sent to any host until then.
legacy.stoppedHint: Its transition period is over: steps using it fail until you set its allowed hosts.

hosts.invalid: Not a host: {{hosts}}. Use api.example.com, *.example.com or host:port — no IP address, scheme or path.
hosts.full: A secret lists at most {{max, number}} hosts.
hosts.savedAs: Press Enter to add — will be saved as {{host}}
hosts.keyboard: Press Enter or a comma to add a host, or paste several. Backspace moves to the last host; Delete removes it.

rules.wildcard: *.example.com: its subdomains only (api.example.com, a.b.example.com) — not example.com itself; add it too if needed.
rules.port: Add :port for a port other than 80 and 443 (hooks.example.com:8443).
rules.noIp: No IP address or range: a URL with an IP address never matches.
rules.notAllowlist: This list does not open internal addresses or other ports — the HTTP allowlist above does. A call must pass both.

banner.title_one: {{count, number}} HTTP secret has no allowed hosts
banner.title_other: {{count, number}} HTTP secrets have no allowed hosts
banner.pending: Secrets created before allowed hosts existed are still sent to any host until their deadline — the first one is {{date}}. After it, steps using them fail.
banner.stopped_one: {{count, number}} of them already stopped sending: steps using it fail now.
banner.stopped_other: {{count, number}} of them already stopped sending: steps using them fail now.
